opening.text: Natalie Foster, a fellow senator, catches up with you in the corridor.
opening.speaker: narrator

segments.speaker: natalie
segments.text: I heard about your position on the Education Reform Bill. That's going to be a tough vote. How are you leaning?

choices.text: "I'm leaning toward support. It's the right policy."

segments.speaker: natalie
segments.text: She nods. "I respect that. Sometimes you have to vote your conscience, even when it's hard."

segments.speaker: natalie
segments.text: "Let me know if you need me to lobby a few colleagues. We're stronger together." She gives you a supportive smile before heading off.

choices.text: "I'll take you up on that. Thanks, Natalie."

consequences.high_trust: Natalie will lobby colleagues on your behalf
consequences.low_trust: Natalie may vote differently, weakening your position
